sentences.text: As the night deepened at 02:00, the ironing room began to host a strange warmth with no discernible source.
This mysterious heat, observed at 22.4 °C, felt notably warmer than the predicted 21.2 °C.
The temperature reached its peak at 03:00, making the house feel like it was being hugged by an unseen spirit.
Finally, the warmth in the ironing room began to recede, lasting until 06:00.
